model_annotation: Figure 4 presents two bar charts, labeled (a) and (b), both titled “各语体中的动词一级语义域分布” (Distribution of Primary Semantic Domains of Verbs in Various Discourse Genres). Both charts compare the frequency of verb usage across four discourse genres — “新闻” (News), “传统文学” (Traditional Literature), “网络小说” (Web Novels), and “微博” (Weibo) — for two different verb types: transitive verbs (图4(a)) and intransitive verbs (图4(b)). The horizontal axis in both charts lists these four genres in the order presented. The vertical axis, labeled “频次” (Frequency), is scaled linearly from 0 to 1000, with tick marks at intervals of 1000. In chart (a), the bars are grouped by genre, with each bar representing the total frequency of transitive verbs in that genre, and the bar is segmented into colored parts indicating the percentage contribution of each semantic domain. The legend on the right identifies the semantic domains by color, including “行为” (Action), “状态” (State), “关系” (Relation), “认知” (Cognition), “情感” (Emotion), “社会” (Social), “自然” (Nature), and “艺术” (Art). In chart (b), the bars are similarly grouped by genre, representing the total frequency of intransitive verbs, and are segmented by color to indicate the percentage contribution of each semantic domain, with the same legend. The bars for each genre are stacked, with the bottom segment representing “行为” (Action) and the top segment representing “艺术” (Art). The bars are not sorted by frequency, and no specific visual emphasis is applied to any particular bar or segment.
